svg.title: Hi, I'm Nesandu — curiosity meets code
svg.desc: Nesandu beside his laptop, framed by red and blue light trails. A developer exploring full-stack software, IoT, and ideas worth building. Currently building Batchmate.

g.text: Sometimes, it even spins into a hologram.
